thread:
Marta: Quick heads-up — Skybridge signed for joint benchmark + marketplace launch. Thinking: short benchmark blog (latency/cost), then joint webinar (tech + customer), and marketplace listing day-of. Timeline: 4-week sprint. Thoughts? :rocket:
Josh: love it. who owns the benchmark infra? can we reuse the internal perf harness?
Marta: @Josh can you lead infra? we'll pair with @Marco on dataset and scenarios.
Josh: yep I can. Marco, you good to scope scenarios?
Marco: I can own scenarios + script. Need model list + seq lengths. pinged @Kevin about infra quota.
Kevin: quota approved for Skybridge pool. also check tenancy for marketplace listing (legal ok?)
Lisa: legal green on co-marketing copy, but they want pre-approval on all quotes. need 48h review.
Noah: landing page and lead routing — propose a single joint landing page with hidden utm params, route to SFDC campaign 'SB-Spring24'. I'll set webhook to HubSpot. need field mapping.
Marta: perfect. Noah, can you add inbound routing doc to Notion and tag @Josh @Marco @Lisa?
Noah: done — https://notion.redwood/sb-launch-inbound (draft). mapping: email, company, title, interest-level, demo-optin.
Josh: for benchmark, propose 3 tests: cold-start latency, steady qps throughput, cost-per-1k-tokens. short exec summary + grafana links.
Marco: agree. I'll draft the exec summary and one slide for webinar pitch.
Lisa: for webinar — two slots: Thurs 10am PT or Tues 11am PT. which works for Skybridge PM and their customer?
Marta: I've asked partner — they prefer Thurs. pencil it in. @launch-bot can you create a calendar poll?
launch-bot: Poll created: Thu 10am PT vs Tue 11am PT. Voting link: https://poll.launch/abcd
Josh: assets checklist: perf harness repo, runbook, data samples, S3 buckets, grafana dashboards, blog draft. I'll create PR templates.
Marta: assign owners: benchmark infra — @Josh; scenarios & slides — @Marco; copy + legal — @Lisa; landing + routing — @Noah; webinar ops — me + partner.
Kevin: marketplace listing: I can handle technical manifest and testing in staging. need partner logo SVG and integration guide.
Marta: ask Skybridge for logo + integration guide by EOD Friday. also need a 60s customer quote for the blog.
Marco: can we get a short customer clip for webinar? I'll ask their customer success contact.
Lisa: reminder: all external comms must pass brand checklist. I'll paste checklist in Notion.
Noah: routing detail — if lead.score >= 70 then immediate SDR ping, else nurture sequence. also tag source=skybridge_marketplace.
Marta: great. target launch date = 4/18. sprint board created in GH Projects, link: https://github.com/redwood/sb-launch
Josh: I'll start baseline runs Monday and post initial numbers by Tue.
Marco: drafting slides tonight, will share tomorrow.
Marta: awesome — status check Friday 9am PT. thanks everyone :tada:
